Title: Azure HDInsight now supports virtual network service endpoint policies

Body.Content:
Azure HDInsight now supports virtual network service endpoint policies, which allow you to filter HDInsight egress virtual network traffic to certain Azure storage accounts.

To enable service endpoint policies on your virtual network, adjust your settings to allow HDInsight service dependent storage accounts.

Learn more about how to configure virtual network service endpoint policies for HDInsight.
